# Role interpretation (reference asset)

How to interpret and use the user's role when giving advice.

- The authoritative role description lives in `workspace/rolbeschrijving.md`; read it there.
- The profile in `workspace/profiel.md` adds persona, context and development direction.
- Use the role to judge **relevance** (the "R" in SMART): a goal matters more when it
  advances the user's role objectives or development plan.
- When advice could conflict with the role's constraints, surface that tension explicitly
  rather than assuming.

This file does not hard-code the role — always read the live workspace files so advice
reflects the user's latest reality.
